verses.he: לְדָוִ֗ד מִ֫זְמֹ֥ור נְאֻ֤ם יְהוָ֨ה ׀ לַֽאדֹנִ֗י שֵׁ֥ב לִֽימִינִ֑י עַד־אָשִׁ֥ית אֹ֝יְבֶ֗יךָ הֲדֹ֣ם לְרַגְלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.ar: لِدَاوُدَ. مَزْمُورٌ قَالَ ٱلرَّبُّ لِرَبِّي: «ٱجْلِسْ عَنْ يَمِينِي حَتَّى أَضَعَ أَعْدَاءَكَ مَوْطِئًا لِقَدَمَيْكَ».
verses.en: A Psalm of David. The LORD saith unto my lord: 'Sit thou at My right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.'
verses.kjv: A Psalm of David. The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.
verses.web: A Psalm by David. Yahweh says to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool for your feet.”

verses.he: מַטֵּֽה־עֻזְּךָ֗ יִשְׁלַ֣ח יְ֭הוָה מִצִּיֹּ֑ון רְ֝דֵ֗ה בְּקֶ֣רֶב אֹיְבֶֽיךָ׃
verses.ar: يُرْسِلُ ٱلرَّبُّ قَضِيبَ عِزِّكَ مِنْ صِهْيَوْنَ. تَسَلَّطْ فِي وَسَطِ أَعْدَائِكَ.
verses.en: The rod of Thy strength the LORD will send out of Zion: 'Rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.'
verses.kjv: The LORD shall send the rod of thy strength out of Zion: rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.
verses.web: Yahweh will send out the rod of your strength out of Zion. Rule among your enemies.

verses.he: עַמְּךָ֣ נְדָבֹת֮ בְּיֹ֪ום חֵ֫ילֶ֥ךָ בְּֽהַדְרֵי־קֹ֖דֶשׁ מֵרֶ֣חֶם מִשְׁחָ֑ר לְ֝ךָ֗ טַ֣ל יַלְדֻתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.ar: شَعْبُكَ مُنْتَدَبٌ فِي يَوْمِ قُوَّتِكَ، فِي زِينَةٍ مُقَدَّسَةٍ مِنْ رَحِمِ ٱلْفَجْرِ، لَكَ طَلُّ حَدَاثَتِكَ.
verses.en: Thy people offer themselves willingly in the day of thy warfare; in adornments of holiness, from the womb of the dawn, thine is the dew of thy youth.
verses.kjv: Thy people [shall be] willing in the day of thy power, in the beauties of holiness from the womb of the morning: thou hast the dew of thy youth.
verses.web: Your people offer themselves willingly in the day of your power, in holy array. Out of the womb of the morning, you have the dew of your youth.

verses.he: נִשְׁבַּ֤ע יְהוָ֨ה ׀ וְלֹ֥א יִנָּחֵ֗ם אַתָּֽה־כֹהֵ֥ן לְעֹולָ֑ם עַל־דִּ֝בְרָתִ֗י מַלְכִּי־צֶֽדֶק׃
verses.ar: أَقْسَمَ ٱلرَّبُّ وَلَنْ يَنْدَمَ: «أَنْتَ كَاهِنٌ إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ عَلَى رُتْبَةِ مَلْكِي صَادَقَ».
verses.en: The LORD hath sworn, and will not repent: 'Thou art a priest for ever after the manner of Melchizedek.'
verses.kjv: The LORD hath sworn, and will not repent, Thou [art] a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek.
verses.web: Yahweh has sworn, and will not change his mind: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”

verses.ar: ٱلرَّبُّ عَنْ يَمِينِكَ يُحَطِّمُ فِي يَوْمِ رِجْزِهِ مُلُوكًا.
verses.en: The Lord at thy right hand doth crush kings in the day of His wrath.
verses.kjv: The Lord at thy right hand shall strike through kings in the day of his wrath.
verses.web: The Lord is at your right hand. He will crush kings in the day of his wrath.

verses.he: יָדִ֣ין בַּ֭גֹּויִם מָלֵ֣א גְוִיֹּ֑ות מָ֥חַץ רֹ֝֗אשׁ עַל־אֶ֥רֶץ רַבָּֽה׃
verses.ar: يَدِينُ بَيْنَ ٱلْأُمَمِ. مَلَأَ جُثَثًا أَرْضًا وَاسِعَةً. سَحَقَ رُؤُوسَهَا.
verses.en: He will judge among the nations; He filleth it with dead bodies, He crusheth the head over a wide land.
verses.kjv: He shall judge among the heathen, he shall fill [the places] with the dead bodies; he shall wound the heads over many countries.
verses.web: He will judge among the nations. He will heap up dead bodies. He will crush the ruler of the whole earth.

verses.he: מִ֭נַּחַל בַּדֶּ֣רֶךְ יִשְׁתֶּ֑ה עַל־כֵּ֝֗ן יָרִ֥ים רֹֽאשׁ׃
verses.ar: مِنَ ٱلنَّهْرِ يَشْرَبُ فِي ٱلطَّرِيقِ، لِذَلِكَ يَرْفَعُ ٱلرَّأْسَ.
verses.en: He will drink of the brook in the way; therefore will he lift up the head.
verses.kjv: He shall drink of the brook in the way: therefore shall he lift up the head.
verses.web: He will drink of the brook on the way; therefore he will lift up his head.
